description: Interactive gene view for one pulse and legume gene: a relationship map of its orthologues across legumes (Ensembl Compara), members of its LIS legume gene family (chickpea, lentil, pea, soybean, Medicago), Arabidopsis function, expression contrasts and recent papers, with tabs for the gene family by species and baseline expression (LIS chickpea and pea atlases, Expression Atlas). Clients that support MCP Apps show it in the chat; the result also lists the nodes, the panel data and the gene page link (page) to share. gene: gene name or Ensembl/LIS ID.
name: pulse_gene_view
